title: Asymmetric Naïveté: Beliefs About Self-Control
eligible_reason: Not eligible: online real-effort laboratory experiment with structural (tobit/maximum-likelihood) estimation of present-bias parameters in MATLAB; no panel difference-in-differences or staggered adoption design. The 'staggered' flag refers to staggered participation dates in the experiment, and 'Borusyak' to a citation.
design_notes: AsymmetricNaivete_wrapper.m runs reduced-form comparisons of decisions versus predictions (self vs others), tobit structural estimation, likelihood-ratio tests, kernel densities, attrition and mechanism analyses on decisions.csv / predictions_*.csv / users*.csv plus a classroom survey.
screener_notes: Screened from package only; readme.txt and file names suffice to rule out a DiD design.
